name: Marathon Lych

name: Speed Demon Vortex
description: Vortex gets 40 % faster every tier, with three evenly spaced skulls.

name: Glass Cannon
description: One Bloonarius at three times the speed and a tenth of the health. Blink and it's gone.

name: No Skulls, No Mercy
description: Elite Phayze without a single skull, every bloon fortified and no selling.

name: Speedrun Dreadbloon

name: Paragon Ban
description: Elite Blastapopoulos on Infernal, Hard, and not a single paragon allowed.

name: CHIMPS Throwback
description: CHIMPS with the earlier boss event rounds: regrow, camo regrow and DDTs, no selling, no continues.

name: Boss Gauntlet
description: Seven tiers, seven bosses: every boss in the game, one after the other.
